blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: A step-03 plan starts project Q in 2030. Finance's NPV for Q is 900 for a 2027 start and 600 for a 2030 start. What does the step-03 objective count for Q?

options.text: 600, since the objective reads the NPV of the start it chose
options.says: Step 03 values every start at the earliest-start NPV; it never reads the NPV by year.

options.text: 900, since every start is valued at the earliest-start NPV
options.says: Right: v_i did not depend on t, which is why the plan claimed value it did not have.

options.text: 750, since the model averages the NPVs over the window
options.says: No average is taken; the earliest-start NPV is used for every start.

options.text: 0, since a late start has no value in the step-03 model
options.says: A late start is valued at the earliest-start NPV, not at zero.

origin.section: The Step-03 Plan Claims Value Its Starts Don't Have

questions.stem: An asset's work takes two years and starts in 2029, in a plan whose last year is 2031. Which years' risk does that start remove in steps/04?

options.text: 2031 only: the years after the work ends, up to the plan's last
options.says: Right: the work ends in 2030, so the risk of 2031 is removed.

options.text: 2029 to 2031: every year from the start up to the plan's last
options.says: The years of work do not count; the asset is not renewed until the work ends.

options.text: 2029 and 2030: the years in which the work is being done
options.says: Risk is removed from the year after the work ends, not during it.

options.text: 2031 and ten years more, to count risk beyond the plan
options.says: Risk after the plan's last year is not counted, so plans compare over the same years.

origin.section: A Coefficient per Variable Prices Each Start Year

questions.stem: Asset management asks steps/04 for the plan that removes the most risk. What does the planner report for that plan?

options.text: Only its risk removed, since a plan reports what it maximized
options.says: Every plan reports both measures, whichever was maximized.

options.text: Its risk, next to the NPV of the NPV plan for comparison
options.says: The NPV reported is the risk plan's own NPV.

options.text: Only its NPV, since risk is computed after the solve ends
options.says: Risk is a model expression, evaluated at the solution and reported.

options.text: Both its NPV and its risk removed, whichever was maximized
options.says: Right: Built holds both expressions and the plan reports both.

origin.section: Maximizing NPV and Maximizing Risk Give Different Plans
